title: Page 7
content_zh:
温希恩气炸了。“你——”

“你们两个在干么？为什么吵架？”被吵醒的温希琳揉着惺忪的睡眼出来看状况。

“姊……”温希恩看到她，想到姊姊为自己的病四处筹钱，却被利用了，就觉得心疼。“姊姊，你怎么那么傻呀？”她心疼地扑入温希琳怀里。

温希琳迷迷糊糊的还搞不清楚状况，疑惑地望向自家老公，不明白这两人怎么会深夜吵起来？

文景瑞看着温希恩手中那份明天就要作废的契约，无奈的对老婆笑了笑，示意她往下看。

温希琳低下头，一看见妹妹捏在手中的文件，整个人瞬间清醒了。“呃……希恩，你别想太多，姊姊不委屈。”

“才怪！如果不是为了我，你才不会遇到这个趁人之危的混蛋！”温希恩用力瞪了表情无辜的文景瑞一眼。

“没办法，谁叫那时候你姊无依无靠，我有权有势，你姊需要钱，我也有需要她的地方，这是一桩买卖。”反正都被怨恨了，文景瑞干脆把话摊开来讲。

“你！”温希恩气到呼吸急促、脸色发白，虽然身体好很多了，但仍无法承受严重的刺激。

“景瑞，你干么故意气希恩？”温希琳实在拿他没辙。

“我说的是事实。希恩，你刚才要我教你数学的时候说你要还我钱，也好，个人造业个人担，你姊姊专心当我老婆就好，至于你嘛……加点油，我还是可以教你学业，把你教到会为止，你可得好好学，用最快的速度变强才行，否则在你不知道的时候，你姊姊可能又会被人欺负了喔。”文景瑞想了想，憎恨是驱使人向上的最佳良药，这可以让温希恩拚了命的想成为温希琳的后盾。

“你跟小孩子说这些做什么？！”温希琳目瞪口呆，被文景瑞的话给气到了。

“姊，这是我们的事！哼，你不要想欺负姊姊，我告诉你，你如果让姊姊受委屈，我就把姊姊带走，让你永远找不到！”温希恩跟文景瑞这臭男人杠上了。

“你知道我人脉有多广吧，要找人并不难，对了，忘记告诉你们，我已经让人找到你们妈妈，也让她同意回来看你姊和小孩。”文景瑞凉凉地道。

“你会老，我会长大，我不会输你！”温希恩怒瞪笑意盈盈的文景瑞，握拳立誓。

“你们两个别吵了……”温希琳柔柔弱弱的劝架声完全掩没在这一大一小的争吵之中。

“你先长高吧。”唉，跟个十四岁小女生吵架真没成就感。

“你——”

“你们不要吵了……”温希琳捧着肚子，皱眉轻喊。

“姊，你看姊夫这么坏，我们回家！”

“这里就是我老婆的家，我老婆和我小孩我自己照顾。”

一大一小仍大眼瞪小眼地争吵着，完全没理会她。

“你们不要吵了！”温希琳难得提高音量大吼，让两个习惯她温声软语的人，惊讶地回头。

只见温希琳全身发抖，眼睛先看看文景瑞，她爱的男人，再看看小妹，她所疼惜的人。“都是你们两个，没事吵什么架，害我气到要提前生了——快点送我去医院，我羊水破了！”

第10章(1)

波塞顿游艇集团总裁的长子要比预产期早了三周出生的消息根本封锁不住，自媒体得知后便守在医院门口，等待最新进展。

早上十点，一名戴着墨镜的女性经过了那群从深夜便在外头等待的众多媒体和SNG车，而各家记者们正在互通消息。

“生了吗？有没有消息？”

“还没，这都痛十个小时了，不会有事吧？”

“呸呸，乌鸦嘴，你不知道文景瑞黑白两道都有势力？这种诅咒他老婆、小孩的话让他听见，你还想不想活了？”

然而那名女性似乎一点也不在意即将出炉的新闻，她笔直地掠过那些人，踏进医院，直接往妇产科方向走。

在妇产科候诊的多半是怀了孕的妇人，或是带着小孩回诊的妈妈，她们都不是一个人来，不是有丈夫陪伴，就是有母亲小心翼翼的搀扶，一群女人还会凑在一起大聊孕妇经。

石澄音在墨镜底下的眼睛布满了血丝，那些怀孕的女人令她嫉妒得眼眶发红，她压下逃走的念头，站在走廊上死命的用双眼搜寻着里外两间候诊室，要找出她想找的那张脸。

“谢谢你，医生。”

此时一对男女从诊间走出来，男的一脸喜悦，回头频频向医生道谢，而后像护着什么宝贝般，扶着小腹突起，怀孕绝对超过四、五个月的年轻女性。

男的约莫三十岁，看起来英俊体面，而女人非常年轻，看起来不过二十出头。

“宝宝很健康，真是太好了！”男人带着笑，脸上全是即将为人父的喜悦。

一见那对男女，石澄音立刻拿下墨镜，她抿着唇，看着她的丈夫和年轻貌美的小三，尤其那隆起的肚皮更是刺痛了她的眼。

“黄品杰，你这个混蛋！”被背叛的痛苦令她忘了自己在哪里，怒吼一声冲到男人面前，用自己的GUCCI包用力揍他。“我嫁给你，让你在我爸手下做事，没有我，你凭什么升上经理？结果你居然拿我们家的钱养女人，你个混蛋——”痛极恨极，石澄音像个疯子般殴打丈夫。

“品杰……”黄品杰身边的女人吓了一跳，一副快哭出来的模样。

听到女人用娇嫩的嗓音亲昵地喊着丈夫的名字，石澄音更为火大，转而将矛头对向她。

“你这个贱女人！敢抢我老公？我半年前就警告过你，离我男人远一点，你这不要脸的女人——”她张牙舞爪地攻击怀孕的女人。

这泼妇般的举动引起候诊室不小的骚动，在这里的多半是孕妇，身体状况不比寻常，纷纷吓得走避。

“你闹够了吧？！”黄品杰因为被抓包，一开始还心虚的不敢反击，只是闪闪躲躲，直到石澄音把矛头对准怀了自己小孩的女人，他才不再挨打。“你这神经病！要发疯滚出去！”

他双手握住石澄音的手腕，一点也不温柔地将她往外拖，边拖边骂，“你以为你还是温家的千金大小姐？先不说你姓石不姓温，自从你爸爸不当总经理后，你以为你还有本钱在外面狐假虎威，以为闹了事还会有人帮你擦屁股？你别傻了，外公已经放话，不再管你外婆和你妈，还有你那些阿姨们，现在的你不过是个可怜虫！

“我已经忍你很久了，你任性、自私、挥霍成性，甚至为了莫名其妙的理由拿掉我的小孩，你不是爱美吗？不是怕怀孕会毁了你的身材，再也穿不了漂亮衣服？这下你如愿了，你就抱着那些漂亮衣服过一辈子吧！”

他把她拖到一条没人的长廊上，接着粗鲁的将她甩开，像她是多么讨人厌的东西一般。

石澄音不敢相信自己会被如此对待，她恨恨地抬头，瞪着结婚多年的丈夫。

她大学毕业就嫁给了眼前的男人，新婚三个月后意外怀孕，那时她还年轻，还没有准备好要当妈妈，加上已经跟姊妹们约好了四个月后要到夏威夷旅行，于是她不顾丈夫的苦苦哀求，拿掉了小孩。

许是她的报应吧，那次流产伤了她的子宫，让她再也无法受孕，夫妻之间的感情也从此变得淡漠疏离。

“去年我就说要离婚，现在我再提一次，我什么都不要，钱、房子都留给你，工作我也不要了，你若不答应，我们就打离婚官司吧，总之我是一定会离开你的，澄音，我是独子，需要传宗接代，所以求你放过我吧。”说完，黄品杰也不想再跟她纠缠，匆匆走了。
content_en:
Wen Xien was furious."You——"

"What are you two doing? Why are you quarreling?" Wen Xilin, who was woken up, rubbed her sleepy eyes and came out to see what was going on.

"Sister..." Wen Xi'en saw her and felt heartbroken when he thought that his sister was being taken advantage of while raising money for her illness."Sister, why are you so stupid?" She threw herself into Wen Xilin's arms distressedly.

Wen Xilin was confused and still couldn't figure out the situation. She looked at her husband in confusion, wondering why the two of them were quarreling late at night.

Wen Jingrui looked at the contract in Wen Xien's hand that would be invalidated tomorrow. He smiled helplessly at his wife and motioned for her to look down.

Wen Xilin lowered her head and suddenly woke up when she saw the document in her sister's hand."Uh...Xian, don't think too much, my sister is not wronged."

"That's weird! If it weren't for me, you wouldn't have met this bastard who took advantage of others!" Wen Xi'en glared hard at Wen Jingrui, who looked innocent.

"I couldn't help it. Your sister was helpless at that time. I was powerful, your sister needed money, and I also needed her. This was a business." Wen Jingrui was resented anyway, so Wen Jingrui simply spoke out.

"You!" Wen Xien was so angry that his breathing became short and his face turned pale. Although his body was much better, he still could not bear the severe stimulation.

"Jingrui, why are you deliberately angry with Xi En?" Wen Xilin really had nothing to do with him.

"I'm telling the truth. Sheen, when you asked me to teach you math just now, you said that you have to pay me back. That's fine. I'll be responsible for my own work. Your sister can just concentrate on being my wife. As for you... Come on, I can still teach you your studies until you're good enough. You canYou have to study hard and become stronger as quickly as possible, otherwise your sister may be bullied again when you don't know it." Wen Jingrui thought about it, hating is the best medicine to drive people forward, which makes Wen Xien desperately want to be Wen Xilin's backing.

"Why are you telling a child this?!" Wen Xilin was stunned and angry at Wen Jingrui's words.

"Sister, this is our business! Huh, don't try to bully your sister. I'm telling you, if you make your sister suffer, I will take her away so that you will never find her!" Wen Xi'en got into a fight with this stinky man Wen Jingrui.

"You know how well-connected I am, it's not difficult to find someone. By the way, I forgot to tell you that I have asked someone to find your mother and get her to agree to come back to see your sister and child." Wen Jingrui said coolly.

"You will grow old, I will grow up, and I will not lose to you!" Wen Xi'en glared at the smiling Wen Jingrui, clenched his fist and swore.

"You two, stop arguing..." Wen Xilin's soft voice of persuasion was completely lost in the quarrel.

"You should grow taller first." Alas, there is no sense of accomplishment in arguing with a fourteen-year-old girl.

"You——"

"Stop arguing..." Wen Xilin held her belly, frowning and shouting softly.

"Sister, you see my brother-in-law is so bad, let's go home!"

"This is my wife's home. I take care of my wife and my children by myself."

The big one and the little one were still arguing with each other, completely ignoring her.

"Stop arguing!" Wen Xilin rarely raised her voice and shouted, causing the two people who were accustomed to her gentle words to turn around in surprise.

Wen Xilin was seen trembling all over, her eyes looking first at Wen Jingrui, the man she loved, and then at her little sister, the person she cherished."It's the two of you. There's nothing to argue about. It makes me so angry that I'm going to give birth early - take me to the hospital quickly, my water has broken!"

Chapter 10(1)

The news that the eldest son of the president of Poseidon Yacht Group was born three weeks earlier than the due date could not be blocked at all. After the media learned about it, they stood guard at the door of the hospital, waiting for the latest developments.

At ten o'clock in the morning, a woman wearing sunglasses passed by a group of media and SNG vehicles that had been waiting outside since late at night, and reporters from various companies were exchanging news.

"Are you giving birth? Is there any news?"

"Not yet. It's been hurting for ten hours. Is everything going to be okay?"

"Bah, crow's mouth, don't you know that Wen Jingrui has power in both black and white? If he hears such curses on his wife and children, do you still want to live?"

However, the woman didn't seem to care about the upcoming news at all. She walked straight past those people, stepped into the hospital, and walked directly to the obstetrics and gynecology department.

Most of the people waiting in the obstetrics and gynecology department are pregnant women, or mothers returning for treatment with their children. They are not alone, accompanied by their husbands, or carefully supported by their mothers. A group of women will get together to talk about pregnancy periods.

Shi Chengyin's eyes were bloodshot under her sunglasses. Those pregnant women made her eyes red with jealousy. She suppressed the thought of running away and stood in the corridor desperately searching the two waiting rooms inside and outside to find the face she was looking for.

"Thank you, doctor."

At this time, a man and woman walked out of the clinic. The man looked happy and turned around to thank the doctor. Then he held the young woman with a protruding belly as if she were protecting a baby. She was definitely more than four or five months pregnant.

The man is about thirty years old and looks handsome and decent, while the woman is very young and looks to be in her early twenties.

"The baby is healthy, that's great!" The man smiled, his face full of joy of becoming a father.

As soon as she saw the couple, Shi Chengyin immediately took off her sunglasses. She pursed her lips and looked at her husband and the young and beautiful mistress, especially the swollen belly that stung her eyes.

"Huang Pinjie, you bastard!" The pain of being betrayed made her forget where she was. She rushed to the man with a roar and beat him hard with her GUCCI bag."I married you and let you work under my dad. Without me, why did you get promoted to manager? But you actually used our family's money to support a woman, you bastard -" Shi Chengyin was so hurt and resentful that she beat her husband like a madman.

"Pinjie..." The woman next to Huang Pinjie was startled and looked like she was about to cry.

Hearing the woman calling her husband's name affectionately in a delicate voice, Shi Chengyin became even more angry and turned to point his finger at her.

"You bitch! How dare you steal my husband? I warned you half a year ago, stay away from my man, you shameless woman -" She bared her teeth and attacked the pregnant woman.

This shrew-like behavior caused quite a commotion in the waiting room. Most of the people here were pregnant women with unusual physical conditions, and they all ran away in fear.

"Have you made enough trouble?!" Because Huang Pinjie was caught, he felt guilty at first and did not dare to fight back. He just dodged and dodged. It was not until Shi Chengyin pointed the finger at the woman who was pregnant with his child that he stopped being beaten."You lunatic! Get out of here if you're going crazy!"

He held Shi Chengyin's wrist with both hands and dragged her out without any gentleness at all, cursing as he dragged her, "Do you think you are still the daughter of the Wen family? Let's not say whether your surname is Shi or Wen. Since your father became the general manager, do you think you still have the capital to act like a bully outside and think that someone will wipe your ass if there is trouble? Don't be stupid. Grandpa has already said that he will no longer care about your grandma, your mother, and your aunts. Now you are just a pathetic person!

"I have tolerated you for a long time. You are willful, selfish, and spendthrift. You even took away my child for inexplicable reasons. Don't you love beauty?Aren’t you afraid that pregnancy will ruin your figure and make you no longer able to wear beautiful clothes?Now you get your wish, just hold on to those beautiful clothes for the rest of your life!"

He dragged her to a deserted corridor and then roughly shook her away, as if she was such a nuisance.

Shi Chengyin couldn't believe that she would be treated like this. She raised her head bitterly and glared at her husband who had been married for many years.

She married the man in front of her right after graduating from college. She unexpectedly became pregnant three months after the wedding. She was still young at the time and not ready to be a mother. Plus, she had already made an appointment with her sisters to travel to Hawaii in four months, so she ignored her husband's pleading and aborted the child.

Perhaps it was her retribution. The miscarriage damaged her uterus, making it impossible for her to conceive again, and the relationship between the couple became indifferent and distant from then on.

"Last year I said I wanted a divorce. Now I mention it again. I don't want anything. I will leave my money and house to you, and I don't want my job anymore. If you don't agree, we will file a divorce lawsuit. In short, I will definitely leave you. Chengyin, I am an only child and I need to continue the family line, so please let me go."After saying that, Huang Pinjie didn't want to tangle with her anymore and left in a hurry.
